datasets.name: Bijie landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: This passage introduces two datasets, one of which is the open landslide dataset compiled by Wuhan University, namely, the Bijie landslide dataset,19 used for landslide detection and recognition.

methods.name: CLBP-DeepLabv3+
methods.summary: A semantic segmentation model that improves DeepLabv3+ by using a modified lightweight MobileNetV2 as the backbone, replacing the original ASPP module with a DenseASPP module fused with strip pooling, incorporating a coordinate attention mechanism, and integrating a completed local binary pattern (CLBP) texture descriptor via a feature aggregation module.
methods.source: Wei Wang, Zhihua Zhang, Xinyu Zhu, and Shuwen Yang
methods.verbatim: We propose a fusion DeepLabv3+ and completed local binary pattern (CLBP) landslide image semantic segmentation method (CLBP-DeepLabv3+)...

availability.author_statement: The data that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author, Zhihua Zhang, upon reasonable request.

reproducibility_assessment: The Bijie landslide dataset is mentioned but not linked, and the custom code for the CLBP-DeepLabv3+ method is not provided or linked, with the authors stating data is available only upon request.
